title: Agents: stop building investor packets by hand.
blurb: DealCaddie Agent Pro: send investor clients one branded link to a private portal where every deal is underwritten, and they rank picks and request showings.

scenes.line: Agents: your investor client wants numbers on three listings.
Pull the listings. Run a CMA. Build a cash flow sheet. Paste in your logo. Attach it all.
Then the questions start. Which one cash flows best? Can you run it at 20% down?
With DealCaddie Agent Pro, you send one branded link.
Your client gets a private portal with your name, photo and brokerage on every page.
Every deal is already underwritten, so the numbers answer their questions for you.
They rank their favorites and request showings right from the deal.
So you know exactly who to show first. Less busywork, happier clients.

cover_sub: Your brand. Their portal. Every deal underwritten.
why: Investor clients stay with the agent who brings them real numbers. Agent Pro does the busywork.
ask: Agents: how many investor clients are you juggling? 👇
